bio.zh: 丹麦园艺家与天文观测者。
bio.en: Danish horticulturist and astronomical observer.

bio.zh: 意大利教育家。
bio.en: Italian physician and educator.

bio.zh: 法国执政与皇帝，任内推动编订法国民法典。
bio.en: French consul and emperor who helped direct the drafting of the French Civil Code.

bio.zh: 法国启蒙时代作家，《论宽容》的作者。
bio.en: French Enlightenment writer and author of the Treatise on Tolerance.

bio.zh: 法国数学家、物理学家，以压强研究、帕斯卡计算器与哲学著述闻名。
bio.en: French mathematician, physicist, calculator designer and philosophical author.

bio.zh: 苏格兰出身的历史学家、神学家与索尔兹伯里主教。
bio.en: Scottish-born historian, theologian and Bishop of Salisbury.

bio.zh: 英格兰哲学家、法学家，《新工具》的作者。
bio.en: English philosopher, jurist and author of Novum Organum.

bio.zh: 美国首任总统，1796年发表卸任告别文。
bio.en: First president of the United States, who published his Farewell Address in 1796.

bio.zh: 英国博物学家，1859年出版《物种起源》。
bio.en: British naturalist who published On the Origin of Species in 1859.

bio.zh: 美国第十六任总统，颁布《解放奴隶宣言》。
bio.en: Sixteenth United States president, who issued the Emancipation Proclamation.

bio.zh: 美国第三任总统、美国《独立宣言》主要起草人。
bio.en: Third United States president and principal drafter of the Declaration of Independence.

bio.zh: 法国哲学家、数学家，1637年出版《谈谈方法》。
bio.en: French philosopher and mathematician who published the Discourse on Method in 1637.

bio.zh: 英国诗人和政论作者，写有《论出版自由》与《失乐园》。
bio.en: English poet and polemicist, author of Areopagitica and Paradise Lost.

bio.zh: 德国作家，《浮士德》作者，也撰写了《色彩论》。
bio.en: German writer of Faust and the Theory of Colours.

bio.zh: 普鲁士博物学家、地理学家，与邦普兰共同开展美洲考察。
bio.en: Prussian naturalist and geographer who surveyed tropical America with Aimé Bonpland.

bio.zh: 瑞典植物学家，《自然系统》作者，推广物种双名命名。
bio.en: Swedish botanist whose Systema Naturae advanced the consistent use of binomial names.

bio.zh: 苏格兰工程师，发明了蒸汽机的独立冷凝器。
bio.en: Scottish engineer who developed the separate condenser for steam engines.

bio.zh: 德裔英国天文学家，1781年用望远镜发现后来定名为天王星的天体。
bio.en: German-born British astronomer who found the object later named Uranus in 1781.

bio.zh: 德国宗教改革者，1522年出版德语《新约》译本。
bio.en: German Reformation figure who published a German New Testament in 1522.

name.zh: 德西德里乌斯·伊拉斯谟
name.zh-TW: 德西德里烏斯·伊拉斯謨

bio.zh: 荷兰人文主义者，1516年推出希腊文与拉丁文并排的《新约》。
bio.en: Dutch humanist whose 1516 New Testament placed Greek and Latin side by side.

bio.zh: 英国哲学家，写有《政府论》和《人类理解论》。
bio.en: English philosopher whose works include Two Treatises of Government and An Essay Concerning Human Understanding.

bio.zh: 英国哲学家，1651年出版《利维坦》。
bio.en: English philosopher who published Leviathan in 1651.

bio.zh: 日内瓦出生的法语作家、思想家，《社会契约论》作者。
bio.en: Geneva-born writer and thinker in French, author of The Social Contract.

bio.zh: 苏格兰哲学家与历史著作者，著有《人性论》和《人类理解研究》。
bio.en: Scottish philosopher and historian, author of the Treatise and An Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding.

bio.zh: 普鲁士哲学家，著有《纯粹理性批判》与《导论》。
bio.en: Prussian philosopher who wrote the Critique of Pure Reason and the Prolegomena.

bio.zh: 盎格鲁爱尔兰作家，1726年出版《格列佛游记》。
bio.en: Anglo-Irish author whose Gulliver’s Travels first appeared in 1726.

bio.zh: 意大利文艺复兴画家与建筑师，受委托绘制梵蒂冈宫室壁画。
bio.en: Italian Renaissance painter and architect commissioned to create frescoes for the Vatican rooms.

bio.zh: 德国艺术家、版画家，编写含几何与透视的《测量四书》。
bio.en: German artist and printmaker whose 1525 measurement treatise covered geometry and perspective.

bio.zh: 英格兰医生，1628年在《心血运动论》论证血液循环。
bio.en: English physician who set out an argument for blood circulation in De Motu Cordis in 1628.

bio.zh: 英国实验科学家，研究电磁感应、电化学和磁光效应，并在皇家研究院长期讲学。
bio.en: British experimental scientist whose work on induction, electrochemistry and magneto-optics was accompanied by public lectures.

bio.zh: 自然哲学家，与罗伯特·胡克研究空气的性质，并在《怀疑派化学家》中重审元素。
bio.en: Natural philosopher who studied air with Robert Hooke and reconsidered the concept of an element in The Sceptical Chymist.

bio.zh: 英国自然哲学家和教士，分离了后来被称作氧气的气体，并撰写电学史。
bio.en: British natural philosopher and minister who isolated the gas later named oxygen and wrote a history of electricity.

bio.zh: 法国化学家，以定量称量研究燃烧和呼吸，并推动化学命名与分类改革。
bio.en: French chemist who used precise weighing to study combustion and respiration and helped remake chemical classification.

bio.zh: 荷兰数学家和物理学家，设计摆钟，辨认土星环的形状并提出光的波动说。
bio.en: Dutch mathematician and physicist who designed a pendulum clock, identified Saturn’s ring shape, and proposed a wave theory of light.

name.zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·奥斯特
name.zh-TW: 漢斯・克里斯蒂安・厄斯特

bio.zh: 丹麦物理学家，观察电流使磁针偏转，并推动科学普及与理工教育。
bio.en: Danish physicist who observed a current deflecting a compass needle and promoted public science education.

bio.zh: 苏格兰道德哲学家和政治经济学家，著有《道德情操论》和《国富论》。
bio.en: Scottish moral philosopher and political economist who wrote The Theory of Moral Sentiments and The Wealth of Nations.

bio.zh: 英国法哲学家与改革倡议者，以功利主义论证法律和公共制度改革。
bio.en: English legal philosopher and reformer who applied utilitarian reasoning to law and public institutions.

bio.zh: 英国小说家，与姐妹合出诗集，以柯勒·贝尔发表《简·爱》。
bio.en: English novelist who published poetry with her sisters and issued Jane Eyre as Currer Bell.

bio.zh: 英国小说家和传记作家，写过《玛丽·巴顿》《南方与北方》和夏洛蒂·勃朗特传。
bio.en: English novelist and biographer whose works include Mary Barton, North and South and a life of Charlotte Brontë.

bio.zh: 英国作家和记者，以政治经济学故事、美国社会观察和公共论辩见长。
bio.en: British writer and journalist known for stories about political economy, observations of American society and public argument.

bio.zh: 英国小说家、评论家和译者，本名玛丽·安·埃文斯，代表作有《米德尔马契》。
bio.en: English novelist, critic and translator Mary Ann Evans, who published Middlemarch as George Eliot.

name.zh-TW: 亨利・華茲華斯・朗費羅

bio.zh: 美国诗人和译者，以长诗闻名，曾组织但丁俱乐部并译出英语《神曲》。
bio.en: American poet and translator who organized a Dante Club and published an English rendering of the Divine Comedy.

bio.zh: 苏格兰数学家，1614年出版第一部对数表。
bio.en: Scottish mathematician who published the first table of logarithms in 1614.

bio.zh: 美国政治家、联邦党人文集作者之一，曾任美国首任财政部长。
bio.en: American statesman, first treasury secretary and a co-author of the Federalist Papers.

bio.zh: 英国哲学家和政治经济学家，《论自由》作者。
bio.en: British philosopher and political economist who published On Liberty.

bio.zh: 美国陆军将领、美国第十八任总统，晚年写作《个人回忆录》。
bio.en: United States general and eighteenth president who wrote his Personal Memoirs late in life.

bio.zh: 英国小说家，《匹克威克外传》最初以分册连载。
bio.en: English novelist whose Pickwick Papers first appeared in illustrated installments.

bio.zh: 苏格兰诗人、小说家，1814年匿名出版历史小说《威弗利》。
bio.en: Scottish poet and novelist who anonymously published Waverley in 1814.

bio.zh: 法国剧作家、演员与剧团负责人，多次改写并上演《伪君子》。
bio.en: French dramatist, actor and troupe leader who staged successive versions of Tartuffe.

bio.zh: 英国诗人，为《抒情歌谣集》扩大版撰写序言。
bio.en: English poet who wrote the preface to the expanded Lyrical Ballads.

bio.zh: 英国人文主义者，《乌托邦》于1516年在鲁汶首次出版。
bio.en: English humanist whose Utopia was first published in Louvain in 1516.

bio.zh: 英国作家和词典编纂者，1755年出版《英语词典》。
bio.en: English writer and lexicographer who published A Dictionary of the English Language in 1755.

bio.zh: 荷兰画家，1642年完成民兵队群像《夜巡》。
bio.en: Dutch painter who completed the militia group portrait The Night Watch in 1642.

bio.zh: 佛兰德斯画家及西班牙外交使者，曾在访英时向查理一世呈献画作。
bio.en: Flemish painter and Spanish envoy who presented a painting to Charles I during a diplomatic mission.

bio.zh: 西班牙宫廷画家，1656年创作《宫娥》。
bio.en: Spanish court painter who made Las Meninas in 1656.

bio.zh: 美国小说家。曾任塞勒姆海关测量官，后来把海关经验写进《红字》的虚构序言。
bio.en: American novelist who turned his years as surveyor of the Salem Custom House into the fictional frame of The Scarlet Letter.

name.zh: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生
name.zh-TW: 漢斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生

bio.zh: 丹麦作家，以童话闻名。丹麦皇家图书馆保存他的手稿、信件、剪纸和图画书。
bio.en: Danish fairy-tale author whose surviving archive includes drafts, letters, paper cutouts and illustrated books.

bio.zh: 德语地区作曲家、管风琴家。任职莱比锡期间创作教会音乐，也领导大学生音乐社演出。
bio.en: German composer and organist who wrote church music in Leipzig and also directed the city’s Collegium Musicum.

bio.zh: 德国作曲家与指挥家。1829年在柏林指挥巴赫《马太受难曲》的复演，后在莱比锡创立音乐院。
bio.en: German composer and conductor who led a Berlin revival of Bach’s St Matthew Passion in 1829 and founded a conservatory in Leipzig.

bio.zh: 意大利歌剧作曲家，创作《塞维利亚的理发师》《奥里伯爵》《威廉·退尔》等作品。
bio.en: Italian opera composer whose work includes The Barber of Seville, Le Comte Ory and William Tell.

bio.zh: 美国散文家与讲演者，出版《自然》，并参与创立超验主义讨论小组。
bio.en: American essayist and lecturer who published Nature and helped form the Transcendental Club.

bio.zh: 美国工程师，与罗伯特·利文斯顿合作，于1807年在哈德逊河推动蒸汽船客运。
bio.en: American engineer who worked with Robert Livingston to develop a Hudson River steamboat service in 1807.

bio.zh: 美国第四任总统，参加1787年制宪会议并留下笔记，参与合著《联邦党人文集》。
bio.en: Fourth U.S. president, participant and note-taker at the Constitutional Convention, and a coauthor of The Federalist.

bio.zh: 美国第六任总统。卸任后任国会众议员，曾为阿米斯塔德案的非洲当事人辩护。
bio.en: Sixth U.S. president, later a member of the House of Representatives and counsel for the Africans in the Amistad case.

bio.zh: 英国议员，废除英国奴隶贸易运动在议会的主要推动者之一，与民间组织和调查者合作。
bio.en: British MP who carried evidence from abolitionist campaigners into Parliament during the campaign against the British slave trade.

bio.zh: 美国废奴活动家，与艾萨克·纳普创办《解放者报》，公开主张立即废除奴隶制。
bio.en: American abolitionist who co-founded The Liberator with Isaac Knapp and made immediate emancipation a public demand.

bio.zh: 奥地利作曲家，长期任职埃斯特哈齐宫廷。在萨洛蒙邀请下赴伦敦举办演出。
bio.en: Austrian composer long employed by the Esterházy court who took his music to London with the help of Johann Peter Salomon.

name.zh: 格奥尔格·弗里德里希·亨德尔
name.zh-TW: 喬治·弗里德里希·韓德爾

bio.zh: 德国出生的作曲家，《弥赛亚》乐谱手稿保留了写作日期和修改痕迹。
bio.en: German-born composer whose Messiah autograph preserves composition dates and corrections.

bio.zh: 德语剧作家和诗人，1794年邀请歌德参与《季节女神》杂志。
bio.en: German-language playwright and poet who invited Goethe to work on Die Horen in 1794.

bio.zh: 法国数学家与《百科全书》共同编辑，撰写1751年首卷的《导论》。
bio.en: French mathematician and Encyclopédie co-editor who wrote the Preliminary Discourse to its first volume in 1751.

bio.zh: 法国博物学家，依据现生动物与化石的解剖比较研究物种灭绝。
bio.en: French naturalist who used comparisons between fossils and living animals to investigate extinction.

bio.zh: 英国化学家，1815年为煤矿照明研制安全灯原型。
bio.en: British chemist who developed prototypes for safer mine lighting in 1815.

bio.zh: 英国历史学家，从1776年开始出版六卷《罗马帝国衰亡史》。
bio.en: English historian who began publishing the six-volume Decline and Fall of the Roman Empire in 1776.

bio.zh: 法国作家和编辑，主持《百科全书》出版并调查巴黎手工作坊。
bio.en: French writer and editor who directed the Encyclopédie and researched Parisian workshops.

bio.zh: 苏格兰诗人与歌词作者，为《苏格兰音乐博物馆》整理和改写民歌。
bio.en: Scottish poet and lyricist who collected and adapted songs for The Scots Musical Museum.

bio.zh: 法国作家，多次在印本《随笔集》上增写并改稿。
bio.en: French essayist who kept revising and expanding his published Essays.

bio.zh: 意大利新古典主义雕塑家，用泥塑、石膏模型与大理石版本推进委托。
bio.en: Italian neoclassical sculptor who developed commissions in clay, plaster and marble.

bio.zh: 英国海军测绘员，指挥奋进号航行并记录塔希提岛的金星凌日观测。
bio.en: British naval surveyor who commanded Endeavour and recorded transit-of-Venus observations in Tahiti.

bio.zh: 法国作家，《悲惨世界》曾中途搁置，流亡期间续写并于1862年出版。
bio.en: French writer who set Les Misérables aside, resumed it in exile and published it in 1862.

bio.zh: 佛兰德斯画家，为贝尼尼制作过一幅来自三个角度的查理一世肖像。
bio.en: Flemish painter who made a three-view portrait of Charles I for Bernini.

bio.zh: 英国海军军官，在1805年特拉法尔加海战前召集舰长沟通计划。
bio.en: British naval officer who convened his captains before Trafalgar in 1805.

bio.zh: 美国政治家，被委托起草1779年马萨诸塞州宪法草案。
bio.en: American statesman entrusted with drafting the Massachusetts constitution in 1779.

bio.zh: 英国贵格会教徒，为英属北美殖民地宾夕法尼亚先后颁行政府框架与特权宪章。
bio.en: English Quaker who issued frames of government and a later Charter of Privileges for colonial Pennsylvania.

bio.zh: 法国诗人，将借自多个传统的寓言改写为押韵故事。
bio.en: French poet who recast fables from several traditions in verse.

bio.zh: 荷兰哲学家，1670年匿名出版《神学政治论》。
bio.en: Dutch philosopher who published the Theological-Political Treatise anonymously in 1670.

bio.zh: 荷兰法学家，将一部受委托的长篇辩护中的章节另行出版为《海洋自由论》。
bio.en: Dutch jurist whose Mare Liberum was published separately from a longer commissioned legal defense.

bio.zh: 英国诗人，将悼念亚瑟·哈勒姆的诗篇逐步编为《悼念集》。
bio.en: English poet who assembled poems for Arthur Hallam into In Memoriam.

bio.zh: 英国诗人，以分册与订阅推出荷马史诗译本。
bio.en: English poet who issued translations of Homer by subscription and in parts.

bio.zh: 英国画家、版画家。以《时髦婚姻》等将社会讽刺做成多幅连续画面。
bio.en: English painter and printmaker who told satirical stories in sequences, including Marriage A-la-Mode.

bio.zh: 意大利文艺复兴诗人、剧作家，《疯狂的奥兰多》的作者，也曾任加尔法尼亚地方长官。
bio.en: Italian Renaissance poet and playwright who wrote Orlando Furioso and served as governor of the Garfagnana.

bio.zh: 法国思想家，《波斯人信札》《论法的精神》的作者，以跨社会比较研究法律与政体。
bio.en: French author of Persian Letters and The Spirit of the Laws, which compares laws and forms of government across societies.

bio.zh: 英国浪漫主义诗人及批评家，与威廉·华兹华斯出版《抒情歌谣集》，其中收录《古舟子咏》。
bio.en: English Romantic poet and critic who worked with William Wordsworth on Lyrical Ballads, which included The Rime of the Ancient Mariner.

bio.zh: 德国语言学家、民俗材料编纂者，与弟弟威廉合编《儿童与家庭童话集》。
bio.en: German language scholar and collector of folk narratives who edited Children’s and Household Tales with his brother Wilhelm.

bio.zh: 法国小说家和剧作家，以《三个火枪手》和《基督山伯爵》等连载小说闻名。
bio.en: French novelist and playwright known for newspaper serials including The Three Musketeers and The Count of Monte Cristo.

bio.zh: 法国小说家，将多部长篇和短篇组织为《人间喜剧》，其中包括《幻灭》。
bio.en: French novelist who drew together a large group of works, including Lost Illusions, under the title La Comédie humaine.

bio.zh: 英国肖像画家、皇家艺术研究院首任院长，发表《艺术讲演》。
bio.en: British portrait painter and first president of the Royal Academy, known for his Discourses on art.

bio.zh: 法国古典主义画家，多年在罗马工作，以重视构图和古代题材的油画闻名。
bio.en: French classical painter based for much of his career in Rome, known for his compositions and subjects drawn from antiquity.

name.zh: 巴托洛梅·埃斯特万·穆里略
name.zh-TW: 巴托洛梅·埃斯特班·穆里羅

bio.zh: 塞维利亚画家，曾为慈善兄弟会作画，并与其他画家创立塞维利亚绘画学院。
bio.en: Seville painter who made work for the Brotherhood of Charity and helped found the city’s painting academy.

bio.zh: 普鲁士学者、外交官和教育改革者，研究巴斯克语等多种语言，并参与创建柏林大学。
bio.en: Prussian scholar, diplomat and education reformer who studied Basque and other languages and helped establish the University of Berlin.

bio.zh: 德国化学家，在吉森推动实验室教学和有机元素分析，亦以《化学通信》面向较广读者。
bio.en: German chemist who advanced organic analysis and hands-on laboratory teaching at Giessen and wrote Chemical Letters for a wider audience.

bio.zh: 德国宗教改革时期的学者，主要起草1530年提交的《奥格斯堡信纲》。
bio.en: German Reformation scholar and principal drafter of the 1530 Augsburg Confession.

bio.zh: 英国诗人，《唐璜》开篇两章于1819年匿名刊行。
bio.en: British poet whose opening two cantos of Don Juan appeared anonymously in 1819.

bio.zh: 法国剧作家，《熙德》由早期的悲喜剧标示改为后期版本的悲剧。
bio.en: French playwright whose Le Cid first appeared as a tragicomedy and later as a tragedy.

bio.zh: 法国数学家和天文学家，先以《宇宙体系论》介绍后续多卷的天体力学。
bio.en: French mathematician and astronomer who introduced the aims of his celestial mechanics in Exposition du système du monde.

bio.zh: 美国参议员，1850年发表三月七日演说，公开支持以妥协维持联邦。
bio.en: U.S. senator who used his Seventh of March speech in 1850 to argue for preserving the Union through compromise.

bio.zh: 法国诗人及政治家，1848年二月任临时政府成员并公开为三色旗辩护。
bio.en: French poet and politician who publicly defended the tricolor as a member of the provisional government in February 1848.

bio.zh: 意大利诗人，《被解放的耶路撒冷》曾在作者未准许的情况下刊行，后大幅改写。
bio.en: Italian poet whose Jerusalem Delivered circulated without his permission before he substantially rewrote it.

bio.zh: 英国政治家，在下议院推动1867年选举改革立法。
bio.en: British politician who helped steer the 1867 franchise reform through the Commons.

bio.zh: 法国宗教改革者，1536年刊行拉丁文《基督教要义》，1541年出版法文本。
bio.en: French Reformer who published the Latin Institutes in 1536 and a French version in 1541.

bio.zh: 英国散文家，与理查德·斯蒂尔合办1711年起发行的《旁观者》。
bio.en: English essayist who launched The Spectator with Richard Steele in 1711.

bio.zh: 苏格兰作家，《法国大革命》第一卷手稿意外烧毁后重写。
bio.en: Scottish writer who rebuilt the first volume of The French Revolution after its manuscript burned.

name.zh: 格奥尔格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格尔
name.zh-TW: 格奧爾格·威廉·弗里德里希·黑格爾

bio.zh: 德国哲学家，1807年出版原拟作为一套哲学系统第一部分的《精神现象学》。
bio.en: German philosopher who published the Phenomenology of Spirit in 1807 as the intended first part of a larger system.

bio.zh: 法国剧作家，《菲德拉》取材于古典悲剧并于1677年首演。
bio.en: French dramatist whose Phèdre drew on classical tragedy and premiered in 1677.

bio.zh: 苏格兰外科医生和比较解剖学教师，为研究和教学持续建设标本收藏。
bio.en: Scottish surgeon and teacher of comparative anatomy who built a collection for research and teaching.

bio.zh: 英国贵格会早期组织者，推动建立地方聚会并以书信联系团体。
bio.en: Early English Quaker organizer who helped establish local meetings and kept in contact by letter.

bio.zh: 英格兰坎特伯雷大主教，参与编写英语《公祷书》，在英国宗教改革中推动礼拜文本变更。
bio.en: Archbishop of Canterbury who helped shape the English Book of Common Prayer during the Reformation.

bio.zh: 法国出生的改革宗神学家。曾在奥尔良学习古典语言，后在日内瓦继续加尔文的工作。
bio.en: French-born Reformed theologian trained in the classics at Orléans who continued Calvin’s work in Geneva.

bio.zh: 法国元帅，出身法国南部，后担任那不勒斯国王。
bio.en: French marshal from southern France who later became King of Naples.

bio.zh: 意大利政治组织者、作家，创立青年意大利，流亡英国期间参与建立伦敦意大利学校。
bio.en: Italian political organizer and writer who founded Young Italy and helped establish an Italian school in London.

bio.zh: 法国数学家与思想家，在法国革命期间向国民立法议会提交公共教育方案。
bio.en: French mathematician and thinker who submitted a plan for public education to the Legislative Assembly during the Revolution.

bio.zh: 英国诗人，少年时创作假托十五世纪布里斯托尔神父托马斯·罗利的诗稿。
bio.en: English poet who as a teenager wrote poems attributed to a fictional fifteenth-century Bristol priest named Thomas Rowley.

name.zh: 安娜·罗贝尔·雅克·杜尔哥
name.zh-TW: 安娜·羅貝爾·雅克·杜爾哥

bio.zh: 法国经济思想家和官员，曾治理利穆赞，后任路易十六的财政总监。
bio.en: French economic thinker and administrator who governed Limousin and served as Louis XVI’s controller-general of finances.

bio.zh: 法国奥拉托利会神父和哲学家，著有《追求真理》，在因果讨论中发展偶因论。
bio.en: French Oratorian and philosopher who developed occasionalism and wrote The Search after Truth.

bio.zh: 法国革命时期的律师和政治人物。任司法部长期间，曾在立法议会呼吁紧急动员。
bio.en: French lawyer and revolutionary politician who, as minister of justice, urged emergency mobilization in the Legislative Assembly.

bio.zh: 苏格兰牧师与社会改革者，曾在格拉斯哥尝试教区济贫，并在一八四三年参与苏格兰自由教会的建立。
bio.en: Scottish minister and reformer who tried parish-based poor relief in Glasgow and helped establish the Free Church of Scotland in 1843.

bio.zh: 法国出生的军政人物，获选为瑞典王储后继承瑞典和挪威王位，开启贝尔纳多特王朝。
bio.en: French-born soldier and administrator elected heir to the Swedish throne who later ruled Sweden and Norway as Charles XIV John.

name.zh: 弗里德里希·戈特利布·克洛普施托克
name.zh-TW: 弗里德里希·戈特利布·克洛普施托克

bio.zh: 德语诗人，曾在莱比锡求学，以多次发表、历年写成的长篇史诗《弥赛亚》闻名。
bio.en: German-language poet who began publishing his long epic The Messiah while a student in Leipzig.

bio.zh: 都铎时期的枢机和大臣，曾主持亨利八世的政务并扩建汉普顿宫。
bio.en: Tudor cardinal and chief minister to Henry VIII who enlarged Hampton Court.

bio.zh: 美国海军军官，少年在戴维·波特家中长大，后来成为美国海军首位上将。
bio.en: A naval officer who grew up in David Porter’s household and became the first full admiral of the United States Navy.

bio.zh: 英国作家与布道者，用《天路历程》写信仰的寓言，也著有《恩典丰盛》。
bio.en: English writer and preacher whose works include The Pilgrim’s Progress and Grace Abounding.

bio.zh: 意大利诗人与古典文本译者，少年就曾在家中书库自学并翻译古希腊诗歌。
bio.en: Italian poet and translator of classical texts who studied in his family’s library and translated Greek poetry as a teenager.

bio.zh: 英国浪漫主义作家，写作横跨诗歌、评论与传记，曾任桂冠诗人。
bio.en: British Romantic writer and poet laureate whose work included poetry, reviews, and biography.

bio.zh: 丹麦—挪威启蒙时期的作家，著有历史作品与丹麦语喜剧。
bio.en: Danish–Norwegian Enlightenment writer whose work included histories and Danish-language comedies.

bio.zh: 苏格兰作家和地质研究者，在自传中记录了克罗默蒂海岸的早年见闻。
bio.en: Scottish writer and student of geology who documented his early encounters with the coast of Cromarty in his autobiography.

bio.zh: 英国宗教思想家，在《自辩录》中讲述其信念变化与皈依天主教的过程。
bio.en: English religious thinker whose Apologia Pro Vita Sua recounts the development of his beliefs and his conversion to Catholicism.

bio.zh: 美国参议员，在重建时期推动以法律保障非裔美国人平等使用公共设施。
bio.en: United States senator who advocated federal protection for African Americans’ equal access to public facilities during Reconstruction.

bio.zh: 苏格兰医生、传教士与旅行作家，在著作中记述了童年工厂生活和非洲旅行。
bio.en: Scottish physician, missionary, and travel writer who published accounts of his childhood in a mill and his travels in Africa.

bio.zh: 法国作家及教育者，为路易十四的孙子编写《忒勒马科斯历险记》。
bio.en: French author and tutor who wrote The Adventures of Telemachus for Louis XIV’s grandson.

name.en: Honoré Gabriel Riqueti, Count of Mirabeau

bio.zh: 法国大革命早期代表，1789年6月23日在议场要求代表坚持制宪誓言。
bio.en: Early French revolutionary deputy who urged representatives to uphold their constitutional oath on 23 June 1789.

bio.zh: 英国首相，在1798年预算中提出新税制，1799年开始征收所得税。
bio.en: British prime minister who proposed a new tax in his 1798 budget, with income tax introduced in 1799.

bio.zh: 瑞典作家，1747年辞去矿务职务，后来陆续出版神学著作。
bio.en: Swedish author who left the Board of Mines in 1747 and published a series of theological works.

bio.zh: 英国历史作家，从1848年起出版由詹姆斯二世即位写起的《英国史》。
bio.en: British historian who began publishing The History of England from the Accession of James II in 1848.

bio.zh: 英国议员，提出促成1792年《诽谤法》的议案，明确陪审团在刑事诽谤案中的职能。
bio.en: British parliamentarian who introduced the bill that became the 1792 Libel Act, clarifying juries’ role in criminal libel trials.

bio.zh: 法国博物学家，组织王家自然史收藏，并主持多卷《自然史》。
bio.en: French naturalist who organized the royal collections and led the multi-volume Histoire naturelle.

bio.zh: 英国首相，1846年在下议院辩护逐步废除谷物关税的政府方案。
bio.en: British prime minister who defended the government’s phased repeal of grain duties in the Commons in 1846.

bio.zh: 法国小说家，本名奥萝尔·迪潘，1832年以乔治·桑的署名发表《印第安娜》。
bio.en: French novelist born Aurore Dupin who published Indiana as George Sand in 1832.

bio.zh: 法语作家，论述德语文化的《论德国》在巴黎印本遭查扣后于伦敦问世。
bio.en: French-language writer whose book on German culture appeared in London after the Paris edition was suppressed.

bio.zh: 英国剧作家，1616年亲自参与编印收录剧本、诗歌和假面戏的对开本。
bio.en: English dramatist who supervised a 1616 folio collecting plays, poems and masques.

bio.zh: 法国书信作者，以写给女儿德·格里尼昂夫人的通信最著名。
bio.en: French letter writer best known for her correspondence with her daughter, Madame de Grignan.

bio.zh: 法国枢机及政治家，推动私人文人聚会成为正式的法兰西学院。
bio.en: French cardinal and statesman who backed the transformation of a private literary circle into the Académie française.

bio.zh: 法国哲学家和天文学家，于1631年记录开普勒预报的水星凌日。
bio.en: French philosopher and astronomer who recorded the 1631 transit of Mercury predicted by Kepler.

name.zh: 戈特霍尔德·埃夫莱姆·莱辛
name.zh-TW: 戈特霍爾德·埃夫萊姆·萊辛

bio.zh: 德国作家，配合汉堡民族剧院剧目连续发表戏剧评论。
bio.en: German writer who published a series of dramatic essays alongside the repertory of the Hamburg National Theatre.

name.zh: 卡米洛·奔索·加富尔伯爵
name.zh-TW: 卡米洛·奔索·加富爾伯爵

bio.zh: 撒丁王国政治家，以外交备忘录推动1856年巴黎会议讨论意大利问题。
bio.en: Sardinian statesman who used a diplomatic memorandum to bring the Italian question before the 1856 Paris Congress.

bio.zh: 英格兰将领和政治人物，从苏格兰率部进入英格兰，参与一六六〇年王政复辟。
bio.en: English general and politician whose move from Scotland helped make the Restoration of 1660 possible.

name.zh: 威廉·希克林·普雷斯科特
name.zh-TW: 威廉·希克林·普雷斯科特

bio.zh: 美国历史作家，著有《征服墨西哥史》等，曾借海外文献及助手撰写历史。
bio.en: American historian who drew on overseas documents and assistance to write histories including The Conquest of Mexico.

name.zh-TW: 皮耶・讓・德・貝朗瑞

bio.zh: 法国歌曲作者，以政治讽刺歌闻名，部分歌曲的出版曾受到法庭追究。
bio.en: French songwriter whose political songs circulated widely and whose published work was prosecuted.

bio.zh: 法国剧作家，早年从事钟表制作，以《塞维利亚的理发师》《费加罗的婚礼》闻名。
bio.en: French playwright once trained in watchmaking, best known for The Barber of Seville and The Marriage of Figaro.

bio.zh: 英格兰航海者和私掠者，于一五七七至一五八〇年领导环球航行。
bio.en: English navigator and privateer who led a circumnavigation between 1577 and 1580.

bio.zh: 法国革命时期将领，曾学习法律，因政治案件被审判后流亡海外。
bio.en: French Revolutionary general who studied law and later went into exile following a political trial.

bio.zh: 爱尔兰诗人与词作者，为约翰·史蒂文森编配的《爱尔兰旋律选》撰写歌词。
bio.en: Irish poet who supplied lyrics for a published series of Irish melodies with arrangements by John Stevenson.

bio.zh: 英国哲学家及神学家，介绍牛顿自然哲学，并与莱布尼茨讨论空间、时间和自然秩序。
bio.en: English philosopher and theologian known for his advocacy of Newtonian science and his correspondence with Leibniz.

bio.zh: 美国一神论牧师，一八一九年在巴尔的摩宣讲关于一神论基督教的讲道。
bio.en: American Unitarian minister whose 1819 Baltimore sermon described a public position for Unitarian Christianity.

bio.zh: 德国作曲家和剧场创作者，推动建立拜罗伊特音乐节与节庆剧院。
bio.en: German composer and theatre-maker who helped establish the Bayreuth Festival and its dedicated theatre.

name.zh-TW: 威廉・梅克比斯・薩克萊

bio.zh: 英国小说家和插画作者。《名利场》起初以分期形式发表，配有他自己的画。
bio.en: English novelist and illustrator who issued Vanity Fair in parts, with illustrations of his own.

name.zh-TW: 格布哈德・馮・布呂歇爾

bio.zh: 普鲁士陆军元帅，在拿破仑战争末期与同盟军队合作，以滑铁卢角色闻名。
bio.en: Prussian field marshal known for working with allied armies late in the Napoleonic wars, including at Waterloo.

bio.zh: 艾蒂安在法兰西学院的演说里谈到，喜剧足以让后人推知社会的变化。
bio.en: Étienne told the Académie française that comedies could help later readers reconstruct social change.

bio.zh: 阿特伯里受教于威斯敏斯特和牛津，后来从事讲论与教会事务。
bio.en: Atterbury studied at Westminster and Oxford before becoming a preacher and churchman.

bio.zh: 布尔沃-利顿从诗歌写到小说，把庞贝的结局放进人物仍在过日子的场景里。
bio.en: Bulwer-Lytton wrote across genres and set a novel in Pompeii while its inhabitants were still getting on with life.

name.zh: 弗里德里希·施莱尔马赫
name.zh-TW: 弗里德里希·施萊爾馬赫

bio.zh: 施莱尔马赫一面翻译柏拉图，一面思考读者如何进入陌生作者的语言。
bio.en: Schleiermacher translated Plato and thought through how a reader enters a stranger’s language.

bio.zh: 阿拉戈年轻时参与延伸子午线测量，把海岛与大陆纳入同一个问题。
bio.en: The young Arago helped extend the meridian survey across mainland and island sites.

bio.zh: 富歇历经督政府、执政府和帝国等阶段，多次任法国警务部长。
bio.en: Fouché held the police ministry across several phases of French government.

bio.zh: 斯宾塞从田园诗写到《仙后》，用不同人物和旅程承载寓意。
bio.en: Spenser moved from pastoral verse to The Faerie Queene, where characters and journeys give allegory a body.

bio.zh: 拉格朗日的《分析力学》改用统一的分析方法组织力学问题。
bio.en: Lagrange organized mechanics using common analytical methods.

name.zh: 约翰·戈特弗里德·赫尔德
name.zh-TW: 約翰·戈特弗裡德·赫爾德

bio.zh: 赫尔德幼时有随家人唱歌的经历，成年后编过跨语言的民歌选集。
bio.en: Herder grew up singing with his family and later assembled a collection of folk songs across languages.

bio.zh: 本森参与外交事务，也在著作里讨论埃及在通史中的位置。
bio.en: Alongside diplomatic work, Bunsen wrote about Egypt’s place in world history.

bio.zh: 笛福写政治小册子、期刊和小说，在不同文体里安排信息逐步出现。
bio.en: Defoe wrote political pamphlets, a periodical, and novels, giving information a different rhythm in each form.

bio.zh: 黑斯廷斯掌管英国东印度公司治下的行政，面对收入和地方治理。
bio.en: Hastings held authority in East India Company government, dealing with revenue and local administration.

bio.zh: 拉梅内少年热心宗教仪式，成年写下《一个信徒的话》，用近似经文的节奏讲社会处境。
bio.en: Lamennais took devotion seriously as a boy and wrote Words of a Believer in a scriptural cadence about social conditions.

bio.zh: 科布登做仓库职员时清早学法语，后来投身贸易政策改革。
bio.en: Cobden studied French early in the morning while working in a warehouse and later campaigned on trade policy.

name.zh: 克里斯托夫·马丁·维兰德
name.zh-TW: 克里斯托夫·馬丁·維蘭德

bio.zh: 维兰德译过莎士比亚，也有《奥伯龙》等诗作。
bio.en: Wieland translated Shakespeare and wrote poems of his own, including Oberon.

bio.zh: 贝克莱讨论视觉怎样提示距离，并把视觉与触觉分开来分析。
bio.en: Berkeley asked how sight suggests distance and distinguished between visible and tangible experiences.

bio.zh: 约翰·劳在法国推进纸币、银行和贸易公司的联动。
bio.en: In France, John Law pursued a design linking paper money, a bank and a trading company.

bio.zh: 曼特农夫人先照看王室子女，后来推动建立圣西尔女子学校。
bio.en: Maintenon cared for royal children and later helped bring the school for girls at Saint-Cyr into being.

bio.zh: 西班牙剧作家，1609年以《作剧新法》解释面向当时戏剧观众的写作选择。
bio.en: Spanish playwright who explained his choices for the audiences of his day in the 1609 New Art of Making Comedies.

bio.zh: 英国古典学者，1732年发表带校注的《失乐园》版本，主张传本受过他人改动。
bio.en: English classical scholar whose 1732 Paradise Lost edition argued that others had altered the transmitted text.

bio.zh: 爱尔兰作家，1773年上演喜剧《委曲求全》。
bio.en: Irish writer whose comedy She Stoops to Conquer was staged in 1773.

bio.zh: 意大利剧作家，在自传中说明悲剧创作的构想、草写与写成韵文三个阶段。
bio.en: Italian playwright who described conceiving, drafting and versifying as three stages of his tragedies.

bio.zh: 爱尔兰出生的英国议员及作家，1790年出版《法国革命反思》。
bio.en: Irish-born British parliamentarian and writer who published Reflections on the Revolution in France in 1790.

bio.zh: 英格兰政治及军事人物，曾以护国公身份同依据新政体召集的议会交锋。
bio.en: English military and political figure whose Protectorate clashed with parliaments convened under its new constitution.

name.zh: 马克西米连·罗伯斯庇尔
name.zh-TW: 馬克西米連·羅伯斯比爾

bio.zh: 法国大革命时期政治家，1794年7月26日在国民公会发表引发激烈争议的演说。
bio.en: French revolutionary politician whose 26 July 1794 speech to the National Convention caused intense controversy.

bio.zh: 法国政治家，主持1833年初等教育立法并向小学教师发出说明信。
bio.en: French statesman who advanced the 1833 primary education law and sent a circular to elementary teachers.

bio.zh: 美国总统，1832年否决延长美国第二银行特许权的法案。
bio.en: U.S. president who vetoed a bill to renew the Second Bank’s charter in 1832.

bio.zh: 日内瓦出生的法国王室财政官，1781年公开发表《呈国王报告书》。
bio.en: Geneva-born French royal finance official who published his Compte rendu au roi in 1781.

bio.zh: 法国化学家和物理学家，1804年先与比奥同乘气球观测，之后单独升空继续测量。
bio.en: French chemist and physicist who made a joint balloon ascent with Biot and a solo ascent in 1804.

bio.zh: 英国作家，在1742年《约瑟夫·安德鲁斯》序言中提出喜剧性散文史诗的写法。
bio.en: English author who used the 1742 preface to Joseph Andrews to describe comic epic in prose.

bio.zh: 瑞士博物学家和诗人，1728年与格斯纳考察山区，之后创作长诗《阿尔卑斯山》。
bio.en: Swiss naturalist and poet who traveled with Gessner in 1728 and drew on the trip for Die Alpen.

bio.zh: 法国神学家和王储教师，1681年出版以宗教与帝国变迁为主线的历史读物。
bio.en: French theologian and royal tutor who published a historical work on religion and empire in 1681.

bio.zh: 法国思想家，1826年开讲实证哲学，后以六卷印行课程内容。
bio.en: French thinker who began teaching positive philosophy in 1826 and published the course in six volumes.

bio.zh: 英国诗人和译者，与书商雅各布·汤森合作于1697年推出维吉尔诗作英译。
bio.en: English poet and translator who worked with bookseller Jacob Tonson on the 1697 English Virgil.

bio.zh: 法国历史作家和政治人物，1845至1862年陆续出版《执政府与帝国史》。
bio.en: French statesman and historian whose History of the Consulate and the Empire appeared in volumes from 1845 to 1862.

bio.zh: 法国哲学家，1822至1840年间陆续推出附注释的柏拉图法语译作。
bio.en: French philosopher who published an annotated French translation of Plato in volumes from 1822 to 1840.

bio.zh: 英国议员和首相，1766年在下议院主张废除北美殖民地印花税。
bio.en: British parliamentarian and prime minister who argued in 1766 for repeal of the American Stamp Act.

name.zh: 弗朗索瓦-勒内·德·夏多布里昂
name.zh-TW: 法蘭索瓦-勒內·德·夏多布里昂

bio.zh: 法国作家，生前反复修订《墓畔回忆录》，作品自1848年起身后连载。
bio.en: French writer who revised his memoirs over many years before they appeared posthumously in serial form in 1848.

bio.zh: 法国元帅，在拿破仑时代担任军队指挥职务，后在法国政府担任部长和内阁首脑。
bio.en: French marshal who held commands under Napoleon and went on to serve in ministerial and cabinet roles.

bio.zh: 法国工程师、数学研究者和政治人物，法国革命期间在公安委员会参与组织工作。
bio.en: French engineer, mathematical writer and revolutionary official who served on the Committee of Public Safety.

name.zh: 佩德罗·卡尔德龙·德·拉·巴尔卡
name.zh-TW: 佩德羅・卡爾德隆・德・拉・巴卡

bio.zh: 西班牙黄金时代剧作家，兼写宫廷剧与宗教戏剧，代表作为《人生如梦》。
bio.en: Spanish Golden Age playwright who wrote court drama, religious plays and Life Is a Dream.

bio.zh: 奥斯曼帝国的阿尔巴尼亚裔地方统治者，从约阿尼纳发展区域行政与势力。
bio.en: Ottoman Albanian provincial ruler who developed a regional center of power around Ioannina.

bio.zh: 德语诗人和作家，定居巴黎后仍以诗与文章评论德语地区政治文化。
bio.en: German-language poet and writer who lived in Paris and continued to engage with German politics and culture.

bio.zh: 英国神职人员，卫理宗运动的组织者之一，在布里斯托推动户外讲道与新房间聚会。
bio.en: English cleric and Methodist organizer who preached outdoors and helped establish the New Room in Bristol.

name.zh: 约翰·约阿希姆·温克尔曼
name.zh-TW: 約翰・約阿希姆・溫克爾曼

bio.zh: 德国古物研究者和艺术史作者，在罗马研究古希腊罗马艺术，并按风格与时期讨论作品。
bio.en: German antiquarian and art historian who studied classical works in Rome and discussed them through differences of style and period.

name.zh: 理查德·布林斯利·谢里丹
name.zh-TW: 理查・布林斯利・謝里丹

bio.zh: 爱尔兰出生的剧作家和英国议员，曾经营德鲁里巷剧院，代表剧作为《造谣学校》。
bio.en: Irish-born playwright and British MP who ran the Drury Lane Theatre and wrote The School for Scandal.

name.zh-TW: 卡爾・瑪利亞・馮・韋伯

bio.zh: 德国作曲家及指挥家，与弗里德里希·金德合作《魔弹射手》，曾任剧院音乐主管。
bio.en: German composer and conductor whose work with the librettist Friedrich Kind produced Der Freischütz.

bio.zh: 苏格兰哲学家，在爱丁堡教授逻辑和形而上学，研究苏格兰常识哲学与逻辑。
bio.en: Scottish philosopher who taught logic and metaphysics in Edinburgh and worked on logic and the Scottish common-sense tradition.

name.zh: 第一代沙夫茨伯里伯爵安东尼·阿什利·库珀
name.en: Anthony Ashley Cooper, 1st Earl of Shaftesbury
name.zh-TW: 第一代沙夫茨伯里伯爵安東尼・阿什利・庫珀

bio.zh: 英格兰政治人物，任过大法官，之后成为围绕王位继承争议的议会反对派组织者。
bio.en: English statesman who served as lord chancellor and later helped organize parliamentary opposition over the royal succession.

bio.zh: 英国改革派议员和演说者，与理查德·科布登一起推动废除谷物法。
bio.en: British reform politician and orator who campaigned with Richard Cobden against the Corn Laws.

bio.zh: 荷兰医生和莱顿大学教师，在医学、化学和植物学方面任教，参与发展床边教学。
bio.en: Dutch physician and Leiden teacher who taught medicine, chemistry and botany and helped develop bedside instruction.

bio.zh: 美国作家和外交官，以《见闻札记》中的故事闻名，曾在西班牙生活和任职。
bio.en: American writer and diplomat known for the stories in The Sketch Book, with periods of travel and public service in Spain.

bio.zh: 法国元帅，尼斯出生，在法国大革命与拿破仑战争期间先后指挥多支部队。
bio.en: French marshal born in Nice who held many commands during the Revolutionary and Napoleonic wars.

bio.zh: 瑞士出生的法语思想家和政治人物，于一八一九年发表比较古代自由与现代自由的讲演。
bio.en: Swiss-born French-language thinker and politician who delivered an influential lecture comparing ancient and modern liberty in 1819.

bio.zh: 德意志人文主义学者与法学家，研究希伯来语，公开反对没收和焚毁犹太书籍。
bio.en: German humanist and jurist who studied Hebrew and publicly opposed the confiscation and burning of Jewish books.

name.zh-TW: 夏爾・奧古斯坦・聖伯夫

bio.zh: 法国文学批评家和作者，撰写《星期一闲谈》，亦研究法国宗教文化史。
bio.en: French literary critic known for the Causeries du lundi and for historical work on French religious life.

bio.zh: 英格兰牧师和宗教作者，在基德明斯特参与教区改革，著有《改良的牧师》。
bio.en: English minister and author who reshaped parish work at Kidderminster and wrote The Reformed Pastor.

bio.zh: 英国医生，以发表有关天花预防的接种研究而闻名。
bio.en: English physician known for publishing work on vaccination to prevent smallpox.

bio.zh: 瑞士出生的自然研究者，研究鱼类化石与冰川，在美国创立哈佛比较动物学博物馆。
bio.en: Swiss-born naturalist who studied fossil fish and glaciers and founded Harvard’s Museum of Comparative Zoology.

region.en: West and Central Asia, and North Africa

bio.zh: 奥斯曼帝国阿尔巴尼亚裔官员，统治埃及期间推动军政、学校与经济组织变革。
bio.en: Ottoman Albanian governor of Egypt who reshaped military, educational and economic institutions.

bio.zh: 鲁汶神学家、伊普尔主教，其《奥古斯丁论》在去世后出版并引发争议。
bio.en: Theologian at Leuven and bishop of Ypres whose Augustinus was published posthumously and became the focus of controversy.

bio.zh: 英国政治人物，在南海泡沫之后领导政府，通常被视为英国第一位首相。
bio.en: British political leader who took office after the South Sea Bubble and is usually regarded as Britain’s first prime minister.

bio.zh: 意大利道明会修士与思想家，用《太阳城》设想一种将城市、知识与制度放在一起的社会。
bio.en: An Italian Dominican thinker who brought city design, knowledge, and institutions together in The City of the Sun.

bio.zh: 法国神学家和哲学家，与皮埃尔·尼科尔合著《波尔罗亚尔逻辑》。
bio.en: A French theologian and philosopher who co-authored the Port-Royal Logic with Pierre Nicole.

bio.zh: 法国学者与作家，曾在索邦演讲中探讨历史记忆与政治共同体。
bio.en: A French scholar and writer who explored historical memory and political community in a lecture at the Sorbonne.

bio.zh: 英格兰海上将领，从陆上的部队指挥转入英格兰共和国的舰队指挥。
bio.en: An English commander who moved from leading forces ashore to directing Commonwealth fleets.

name.zh: 约瑟夫·尤斯图斯·斯卡利杰
name.zh-TW: 約瑟夫·尤斯圖斯·斯卡利傑

bio.zh: 欧洲文献学家，将多种古代纪年对齐在可比较的时间框架中。
bio.en: A philologist who brought several ancient dating systems into a comparable chronology.

bio.zh: 意大利数学家与医师，在《大术》中公开论述三次和四次方程的解法。
bio.en: An Italian mathematician and physician who put methods for solving cubic and quartic equations in print in Ars Magna.

bio.zh: 英格兰诗人，《任务》从一件沙发写到自然、家居与社会。
bio.en: An English poet whose long poem The Task moves from a sofa to nature, household life, and society.

bio.zh: 法国浪漫主义作家，《洛伦扎乔》最初为阅读而出版，后来才登上舞台。
bio.en: A French Romantic writer whose Lorenzaccio appeared first in print and gained a stage life later.

name.zh: 克洛德·阿德里安·爱尔维修
name.zh-TW: 克洛德·阿德里安·愛爾維修

bio.zh: 法国启蒙思想家，在《论精神》中追问感受、利益和教育怎样形成判断。
bio.en: A French Enlightenment thinker who asked how sensation, interest, and education shape judgment in De l'esprit.

name.zh: 奥古斯坦·皮拉姆斯·德康多尔
name.zh-TW: 奧古斯坦·皮拉姆斯·德康多爾

bio.zh: 瑞士植物学家，研究如何用多种器官特征构成自然分类。
bio.en: A Swiss botanist who sought a natural system of classification using the features of multiple organs.

bio.zh: 英格兰外交官和随笔作家，在《论诗》中比较不同地区与传统的诗歌。
bio.en: An English diplomat and essayist who considered poetry across cultures in Of Poetry.

name.zh: 乔瓦尼·皮耶路易吉·达·帕莱斯特里纳
name.zh-TW: 喬瓦尼·皮耶路易吉·達·帕萊斯特里納

bio.zh: 意大利作曲家，以礼仪多声部合唱闻名，代表作包括《教皇马切洛弥撒》。
bio.en: An Italian composer known for liturgical polyphony, including the Pope Marcellus Mass.

bio.zh: 苏格兰历史学家，用比较材料撰写《美洲史》，并在序言交代所能获取的记录。
bio.en: A Scottish historian who compared sources in History of America and discussed the records he could obtain in its preface.

name.zh: 大卫·弗里德里希·施特劳斯
name.zh-TW: 大衛·弗里德里希·史特勞斯

bio.zh: 德国神学作家，在《耶稣传》中以文本批评重新讨论福音书叙事。
bio.en: A German theological writer who reexamined the Gospel narratives through textual criticism in The Life of Jesus.

bio.zh: 法国枢机与政治家，组织私人藏书向学者开放，并将重建的收藏与学院相连。
bio.en: French cardinal and statesman who opened his library to scholars and tied the rebuilt collection to a college.

bio.zh: 英格兰作家和殖民活动参与者，囚于伦敦塔时写下1614年问世的《世界史》。
bio.en: English author and participant in colonization who wrote his 1614 History of the World while held in the Tower of London.

bio.zh: 意大利枢机，在皮亚琴察推动创办为青年教士提供教育的学院。
bio.en: Italian cardinal who founded a college in Piacenza to educate young clergy.

bio.zh: 德国哲学家，1807至1808年冬季在柏林连续讲演，后整理出版。
bio.en: German philosopher who delivered a series of Berlin lectures in the winter of 1807–08 and published them.

name.zh: 阿尔布雷希特·冯·华伦斯坦
name.zh-TW: 阿爾布雷希特·馮·華倫斯坦

bio.zh: 波希米亚贵族和军事人物，将伊钦作为居所与领地建设的重要地点。
bio.en: Bohemian nobleman and military figure who chose Jičín as a residence and a focus of development in his estates.

name.zh: 弗里德里希·威廉·约瑟夫·谢林
name.zh-TW: 弗里德里希·威廉·約瑟夫·謝林

bio.zh: 德国哲学家，1841至1842年在柏林讲授启示哲学，留下不同笔记与文本版本。
bio.en: German philosopher whose 1841–42 Berlin lectures on revelation survive in several sets of notes and versions.

bio.zh: 英国东印度公司在孟加拉的殖民官员，1770年代在议会调查中多次为本人任职时的行为辩护。
bio.en: British East India Company colonial official in Bengal who defended his administration during parliamentary inquiries in the 1770s.

bio.zh: 法国军事人物和回忆录作者，跨多年经历的九卷回忆录在1857年身后出版。
bio.en: French military figure and memoirist whose nine-volume memoirs appeared posthumously in 1857.

bio.zh: 意大利布道者，部分讲道从现场记录整理为佛罗伦萨早期印本。
bio.en: Italian preacher whose sermons were taken down from live delivery and printed in Florence.

name.zh: 约翰·丘吉尔，第一代马尔伯勒公爵
name.zh-TW: 約翰·邱吉爾，第一代馬爾博羅公爵

bio.zh: 英国军事与政治人物，布莱尼姆宫因授予他的纪念安排而兴建。
bio.en: British military and political figure for whom Blenheim Palace was commissioned as a national monument and residence.

bio.zh: 瑞士宗教改革者，1523年参与苏黎世公开辩论，此前曾为斋戒争议布道及刊印文章。
bio.en: Swiss Reformer who joined the Zurich disputation of 1523 after addressing a fasting controversy in sermon and print.

bio.zh: 英国外交大臣，1825年在下议院解释为何布宜诺斯艾利斯使节未获正式接见。
bio.en: British foreign secretary who explained in 1825 why an envoy from Buenos Aires had not been formally received.

bio.zh: 德语剧作家，用《厌世与悔恨》等舞台作品处理观众喜爱的家庭冲突。
bio.en: A German-language playwright who staged emotionally charged family conflicts in works such as Misanthropy and Repentance.

bio.zh: 法国律师与议员，早年已参与庭辩并撰写民法著作。
bio.en: A French lawyer and legislator who argued cases and published on civil law early in his career.

name.zh: 弗里德里希·奥古斯特·沃尔夫
name.zh-TW: 弗里德里希·奧古斯特·沃爾夫

bio.zh: 德国古典学者，用《荷马导论》重新追问史诗成篇和流传的过程。
bio.en: A German classicist who reopened questions about the creation and transmission of the epics in Prolegomena to Homer.

name.zh: 克里斯托夫·维利巴尔德·格鲁克
name.zh-TW: 克里斯托夫·維利巴爾德·格魯克

bio.zh: 歌剧作曲家，《阿尔切斯特》序言提出音乐应推动戏剧情境。
bio.en: An opera composer whose Alceste preface argues that music should serve the dramatic action.

bio.zh: 英国历史学家，在十二卷《希腊史》中区分传说时期与有纪事可考的时期。
bio.en: An English historian who distinguished the legendary and historical periods in his twelve-volume History of Greece.

bio.zh: 第四代切斯特菲尔德伯爵和英国政治家，以写给儿子的书信闻名。
bio.en: The fourth Earl of Chesterfield, a British statesman known for his letters to his son.

bio.zh: 法国军政官员，在复辟时期推动一八一八年军队招聘与组织法律。
bio.en: A French military administrator who pushed for the 1818 law on recruitment and organization during the Restoration.

bio.zh: 英国神学作家，在《摩西的神圣使命》中把他认为经文未写明的教义用作论证。
bio.en: An English theological author who built an argument around what he saw as an omission in The Divine Legation of Moses.

bio.zh: 法国共和派政治家，一八七〇年离开被围困的巴黎，在外地参与维持政府运作。
bio.en: A French Republican politician who left besieged Paris in 1870 and helped keep the government working outside the capital.

bio.zh: 美国内战期间的南方邦联将领，一八六五年在阿波马托克斯向联邦军投降。
bio.en: A Confederate general during the U.S. Civil War who surrendered to Union forces at Appomattox in 1865.

bio.zh: 英国外交官和外交大臣，在一八五六年巴黎会议代表英国参与外交谈判。
bio.en: A British foreign secretary who represented Britain in negotiations at the 1856 Paris Congress.

bio.zh: 美国联邦军将领，其回忆录记录了谢南多厄河谷战役及对民用生产造成的损毁。
bio.en: A United States general whose memoirs record the Shenandoah campaign and its destruction of civilian production.

bio.zh: 法国元帅，曾在拿破仑远征俄国撤退时担任后卫，后因一八一五年事件受审。
bio.en: French marshal who led rear-guard forces during the retreat from Russia and was tried after the events of 1815.

name.zh: 马里-弗朗索瓦-格扎维埃·比沙
name.zh-TW: 馬里－弗朗索瓦－格扎維埃・比夏

bio.zh: 法国医师与解剖学家，将组织作为理解人体结构和疾病的重要观察层次。
bio.en: French physician and anatomist who made the study of tissues central to how anatomy and disease could be understood.

name.zh-TW: 威廉・特庫姆塞・謝爾曼

bio.zh: 美国陆军将领，在美国内战中任联邦军指挥官，战后出版回忆录。
bio.en: U.S. general who commanded Union forces in the Civil War and published memoirs afterward.

bio.zh: 法国社会思想家，著述讨论工业社会、知识与政治组织，曾与奥古斯特·孔德合作。
bio.en: French social thinker who wrote about industry, knowledge and political organization and worked with Auguste Comte.

bio.zh: 英国议员和报刊作者，因《北方不列颠人》文章及米德尔塞克斯选举争议知名。
bio.en: British MP and journalist whose writings in The North Briton and contested Middlesex elections became public controversies.

bio.zh: 英国政论作者和议员，《乡村骑行记》记录他旅行期间所见的乡村经济与生活。
bio.en: British journalist and MP whose Rural Rides recorded rural conditions and economic life during his travels.

bio.zh: 法国天文学家及政治人物，主持网球场宣誓，后任法国革命初期的巴黎市长。
bio.en: French astronomer who presided over the Tennis Court Oath and became mayor of Paris early in the Revolution.

name.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·勒普雷斯特·德·沃邦
name.zh-TW: 塞巴斯蒂安・勒普雷斯特・德・沃邦

bio.zh: 法国工程师与元帅，参与设计众多防御建筑及城市工程，晚年撰写税制方案。
bio.en: French engineer and marshal who shaped many fortified and urban sites and proposed reforms to taxation late in life.

bio.zh: 法国出生的学者，在荷兰工作，编写《历史与批判辞典》，讨论信仰、宽容与史实核查。
bio.en: French-born scholar whose Historical and Critical Dictionary brought source criticism and debates about toleration into the reference book.

name.zh-TW: 皮耶特羅・梅塔斯塔西奧

bio.zh: 意大利诗人和歌剧剧本作者，曾任维也纳宫廷诗人，作品由不同作曲家先后谱曲。
bio.en: Italian librettist and poet at the Viennese court whose texts were set by many composers.

name.zh-TW: 雅克－奧古斯特・德・圖

bio.zh: 法国法官、图书馆管理者和历史作者，著有多卷拉丁文同时代史。
bio.en: French magistrate, royal librarian and historian whose multi-volume work recorded the history of his own times in Latin.

bio.zh: 英国法律与政治人物，1826年推动成立普及实用知识学会。
bio.en: British lawyer and politician who helped found the Society for the Diffusion of Useful Knowledge in 1826.

bio.zh: 西班牙殖民征服者，在1520年的第二封信里向查理五世呈述在墨西哥的行动。
bio.en: Spanish conquistador who reported his actions in Mexico to Charles V in his second letter in 1520.

bio.zh: 意大利统一运动参与者，1860年志愿军解散后退居卡普雷拉岛。
bio.en: Participant in Italian unification who retreated to Caprera after his volunteer force was disbanded in 1860.

name.zh: 巴托尔德·格奥尔格·尼布尔
name.zh-TW: 巴托爾德·格奧爾格·尼布爾

bio.zh: 德国历史学家，以《罗马史》和波恩讲课讨论早期罗马记载的可靠性。
bio.en: German historian who used his History of Rome and Bonn lectures to question the evidence for early Roman history.

name.zh-TW: 米歇爾・德・洛皮塔爾

bio.zh: 法国法学家与大法官，法国宗教内战前为教派谈判和限定条件下的宗教共处制定政策。
bio.en: French jurist and chancellor who helped organize religious negotiations and formulate limited terms for coexistence.

bio.zh: 法国大革命时期的医生、报刊作者和政治人物，以《人民之友》报闻名。
bio.en: Physician, journalist and politician of the French Revolution best known for his newspaper L’Ami du peuple.

name.zh-TW: 法蘭契斯科・圭恰迪尼

bio.zh: 佛罗伦萨政治人物、外交官与历史作者，家族档案保存其信件、文书和手稿。
bio.en: Florentine diplomat, statesman and historian whose archive preserves correspondence, documents and working manuscripts.

name.zh: 永斯·雅各布·贝采利乌斯
name.zh-TW: 永斯・雅各布・貝采利烏斯

bio.zh: 瑞典化学家，发展以字母表示元素的化学符号，也以分析与教学推动化学研究。
bio.en: Swedish chemist who advanced chemical analysis and introduced a notation using letter symbols for elements.

name.zh: 皮埃尔-维克蒂尼安·韦尼奥
name.zh-TW: 皮耶－維克蒂尼安・韋尼奧

bio.zh: 法国律师及革命时期议员，吉伦特派的知名演说者，曾任代议机构主席。
bio.en: French lawyer and Revolution-era deputy known for his Girondin speeches and his work presiding over a representative assembly.

bio.zh: 英格兰主教，参与领导詹姆斯王钦定版《圣经》的威斯敏斯特译组，亦以讲道闻名。
bio.en: English bishop and preacher who led work in a Westminster company of translators for the King James Bible.

bio.zh: 威尼斯修士、政府顾问及历史作者，原名彼得罗，入会后名保罗，著有《特伦托会议史》。
bio.en: Venetian friar, government adviser and historian of the Council of Trent, born Pietro and known in religion as Paolo Sarpi.

bio.zh: 德语浪漫主义作家和编辑，参与整理德语莎士比亚译本，多萝特娅·蒂克等人亦承担翻译。
bio.en: German Romantic writer and editor involved in a Shakespeare translation project to which Dorothea Tieck and others directly contributed.

bio.zh: 爱尔兰律师与政治组织者，依托全国性动员推动天主教徒获得更多政治权利。
bio.en: Irish lawyer and organizer who built a mass campaign for Catholics to gain political rights.

bio.zh: 美国政治家，任林肯和安德鲁·约翰逊政府的国务卿，并参与谈判购买阿拉斯加。
bio.en: U.S. secretary of state under Lincoln and Andrew Johnson who negotiated the Alaska purchase.

bio.zh: 英国海军军官和北极考察者，早年组织北岸考察，后指挥一八四五年出发的航行。
bio.en: British naval officer who led Arctic surveying expeditions and commanded the voyage that left in 1845.
